diffs.diff: temperature_C: datasheet reading gives 0.5 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The model already uses 0.5 °C per count (description and build notes give 0.5 °C per LSB, 0032h = +25.0 °C; the onewire-temp simulator kind for family 10h has no scale field for the gate to compare), matching the datasheet: 'has 9-bit resolution, which corresponds to 0.5°C steps'.
